title: Board Game
statementMd:
You are playing a board card game. In this game the player has two characteristics, $*x*$ and $*y*$ — the white magic skill and the black magic skill, respectively. There are $*n*$ spell cards lying on the table, each of them has four characteristics, $*a*_{*i*}$, $*b*_{*i*}$, $*c*_{*i*}$ and $*d*_{*i*}$. In one move a player can pick one of the cards and cast the spell written on it, but only if first two of it's characteristics meet the requirement $*a*_{*i*} ≤ *x*$ and $*b*_{*i*} ≤ *y*$, i.e. if the player has enough magic skill to cast this spell. However, after casting the spell the characteristics of a player change and become equal to $*x* = *c*_{*i*}$ and $*y* = *d*_{*i*}$.

At the beginning of the game both characteristics of a player are equal to zero. The goal of the game is to cast the $*n*$-th spell. Your task is to make it in as few moves as possible. You are allowed to use spell in any order and any number of times (for example, you may not use some spells at all).

## Input

The first line of the input contains a single integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100 000$) — the number of cards on the table.

Each of the next $*n*$ lines contains four integers $*a*_{*i*}$, $*b*_{*i*}$, $*c*_{*i*}$, $*d*_{*i*}$ ($0 ≤ *a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*}, *c*_{*i*}, *d*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$) — the characteristics of the corresponding card.

## Output

In the first line print a single integer $*k*$ — the minimum number of moves needed to cast the $*n*$-th spell and in the second line print $*k*$ numbers — the indices of the cards in the order in which you should cast them. In case there are multiple possible solutions, print any of them.

If it is impossible to cast the $*n*$-th spell, print $- 1$.
statementZhMd:
你正在玩一款棋盘卡牌游戏。在这款游戏中，玩家有两个属性，$*x*$ 和 $*y*$，分别表示白魔法技能和黑魔法技能。桌上有 $*n*$ 张咒语卡牌，每张卡牌都有四个属性：$*a*_{*i}$、$*b*_{*i}$、$*c*_{*i}$ 和 $*d*_{*i}$。玩家可以在一次操作中选择一张卡牌并施放其上的咒语，但必须满足它的前两个属性要求 $*a*_{*i}$ ≤ $*x*$ 且 $*b*_{*i}$ ≤ $*y*$，也就是说，玩家必须拥有足够的魔法技能才能施放该咒语。不过，施放咒语后，玩家的属性会发生变化，变为 $*x*$ = $*c*_{*i}$ 且 $*y*$ = $*d*_{*i}$。

游戏开始时，玩家的两个属性都等于零。游戏的目标是施放第 $*n*$ 个咒语。你的任务是用尽可能少的操作完成这一目标。你可以按任意顺序、任意次数使用咒语（例如，可以完全不使用某些咒语）。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100 000$），表示桌上的卡牌数量。

接下来的 $*n*$ 行中，每行包含四个整数 $*a*_{*i}$、$*b*_{*i}$、$*c*_{*i}$、$*d*_{*i}$（$0 ≤ *a*_{*i}, *b*_{*i}, *c*_{*i}, *d*_{*i} ≤ 10^{9}$），表示相应卡牌的属性。

## 输出格式

第一行输出一个整数 $*k*$，表示施放第 $*n*$ 个咒语所需的最少操作次数；第二行输出 $*k*$ 个整数，表示应当施放的卡牌编号，顺序即为施放顺序。如果有多个可行解，输出任意一个即可。

如果无法施放第 $*n*$ 个咒语，输出 $- 1$。
